title: On the Learnability of Model Reprogramming: A Reachability and Relabeling Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.33889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model reprogramming adapts a frozen source model to a target task by wrapping it in a learnable input transformation from target input to the source-model input space, and an output mapping from source-model outputs to target predictions. Despite extensive empirical progress, the finite-sample learnability of the induced wrapper hypothesis class $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ remains underexplored. We address this for source models that expose hard source labels and analyze it through the wrapper structure: on any target samples, the input transformation selects reachable source labels that the output mapping relabels. Through this lens, we answer two questions: (1) how many target samples are needed to approach the best predictor in $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$, and (2) what gap remains between the optimum over $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ and the target Bayes risk. translated_title: 论模型重编程的可学习性：可达性与重标记视角
translated_abstract: 模型重编程通过将一个冻结的源模型包装在可学习的结构中使其适应目标任务：包括一个从目标输入空间到源模型输入空间的可学习输入变换，以及一个从源模型输出到目标预测的输出映射。尽管已取得大量实证进展，由此诱导出的包装器假设类 $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ 的有限样本可学习性仍未得到充分探索。我们针对暴露硬源标签的源模型研究这一问题，并通过包装器结构进行分析：在任何目标样本上，输入变换会选择可到达的源标签，输出映射再对其进行重标记。通过这一视角，我们回答了两个问题：(1) 需要多少目标样本才能逼近 $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ 中的最佳预测器；(2) $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ 上的最优解与目标贝叶斯风险之间还存在多大差距。对于问题 (1)，包装器结构对 $\mathcal{F}_{\rm MR}$ 的逐样本复杂度进行了分解（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文从可达性与重标记的视角系统研究了模型重编程包装器假设类的有限样本可学习性，回答了逼近该类最佳预测器所需的目标样本数量以及其最优解与目标贝叶斯风险之间的差距这两个核心理论问题。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies the finite-sample learnability of the model reprogramming wrapper hypothesis class from a reachability and relabeling perspective, answering how many target samples are needed to approach its best predictor and what gap remains between its optimum and the target Bayes risk.
